overall_goal: Tidy the kitchen, wash the juicer parts, and serve the fresh orange juice

goals.description: Tidy the countertop and cover the pan
goals.rationale: The person moves a mug, kettle, and wooden spoon out of the way before covering the pan with a lid.

goals.description: Scrape and rinse the juicer top part
goals.rationale: The person uses a knife to scrape the juicer strainer, then removes the top part of the juicer and rinses it under the tap.

goals.description: Empty and rinse the juicer strainer
goals.rationale: The person empties the orange bits from the strainer into the food waste bin, rinses the strainer thoroughly, and dries their hands.
The person retrieves a glass from the cupboard and pours the freshly squeezed orange juice from the food processor bowl into it.
The person rinses, lathers with a sponge, and washes the food processor bowl before placing it on the drainer.

goals.description: Cover the pot and prepare to empty the food waste bin
goals.rationale: The person places a lid on a pot, dries their hands, and lifts the heavy food waste bin to empty it.
